name: hero
whatItDemonstrates: A basic styled Button rendering a native <button> labeled 'Submit', with hover, active, focus-visible, and disabled visual states handled purely through styling hooks (data-disabled/disabled selectors).

name: loading
whatItDemonstrates: A Button that enters a loading state on click — disabled yet still keyboard-focusable, with its label swapping from 'Submit' to 'Submitting' — then re-enables itself after 4 seconds.
stateManaged: controlled — demo-level useState `loading` wraps the `disabled` prop and derives the label text (Button itself stays uncontrolled); `loading` resets to false via setTimeout(…, 4000) in the onClick handler
nonTrivialInteractions: Clicking while enabled sets loading=true, disabling the button and swapping the label to 'Submitting'; a 4-second setTimeout then resets loading=false, re-enabling it
focusableWhenDisabled keeps the disabled (loading) button keyboard-focusable instead of dropping focus
aria-labelledby (backed by React.useId) points at the inner label span so the text change during loading updates the button's accessible name
